Devon: Quick heads-up  planning a 22:15 UTC change window for a small staged release: API header routing, runtime kernel pin, console toggle. Need api/runtime/router/console coord. Rollback gates: 5xx > 0.6% OR p99 increase > 900ms sustained 3m.

Meera: Copy. I'll freeze console schema merges until router + runtime are green. Which runtime build are we pinning?

Devon: Pin runtime -> rtx-2.3.0-hotfix. Fallback rtx-2.2.7. Router header key: X-RD-Canary with values `kern-new` / `kern-old`. Deploy order: wave1 api+runtime, wave2 router, wave3 console toggle.

Kai: I can flip router. Flag `hdr-canary-split`. Suggest 2% canary to start.

Devon: @deploy-bot schedule waves; wave1=22:15 2%, wave2=22:25 2%, wave3=22:35 2%.

deploy-bot: Scheduling canary waves:
- wave1: api, runtime @ 22:15 UTC (2%)
- wave2: router @ 22:25 UTC (2%)
- wave3: console @ 22:35 UTC (2%)
Preflight commands:
```
/deploy create --service api --image api:release-2026-03-xx --wave 1
/deploy create --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.3.0-hotfix --wave 1
```

Olga: Ops note: dashboards patched for metric rename `api.request.router_version` -> `api.request.route_variant`. I'll keep a 30m watch after full rollout. Added artifact checksum to runbook.

Kai: Staging config for header split:
```
route_split:
  header: X-RD-Canary
  variants:
    kern-old: 98
    kern-new: 2
```

deploy-bot: Preflight checks PASS (artifacts present, api->runtime deps ok, GPU capacity ok).

deploy-bot: Wave1 started at 22:15 UTC  id=wave-9092 target 2%.

deploy-bot: Wave1 results (22:21 UTC): api p99 +0.04ms, errors 0.01% -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave2 started at 22:25 UTC  router flag rotated for 2% traffic.

deploy-bot: Wave2 results (22:31 UTC): routing stable, no config drift -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave3 started at 22:35 UTC  console toggle enabled for 2%.

deploy-bot: Wave3 results (22:41 UTC): console canary fine, full rollout scheduled at 22:55 UTC.

Meera: Holding console PR merge until 15m after full rollout. If any gate trips: revert header to kern-old + `/deploy rollback --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.2.7`.

Olga: Ops watching; will open incident if thresholds breach.

Devon: Release notes draft: kernel selection tuning (rtx-2.3.0-hotfix), header-driven gradual rollout, console schema v5 behind toggle. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/1499. Thanks all.
